title: Optimisers in torch.optim
learning_objectives: Run the zero_grad / backward / step cycle with torch.optim
Compare SGD, SGD with momentum, Adam and AdamW on the same problem
Explain what weight decay does and how AdamW applies it
hints: Map the name to a constructor with a dict of lambdas, raising ValueError for unknown names.
In the loop: `opt.zero_grad()`, compute the loss from `p[0]` and `p[1]`, record `loss.item()`, `backward()`, `step()`.

failure_feedback.advice: Record the loss, call backward, then opt.step(); SGD moves by -lr × gradient.
Raise ValueError for names other than sgd, momentum, adam and adamw.
